The SKILL.md files in the music-generation, text-to-speech, sound-effects, song-generation and video-editing folders come from the "awesome-genmedia/skills" repository by each::labs (Copyright (c) 2025 each::labs), released under the MIT License; the full license text is in the LICENSE file alongside them. Only these five documentation files and the license were copied, unmodified, and no code from that repository is bundled. The documents describe calls to each::labs' hosted generation API (eachsense-agent.core.eachlabs.run), which is a separate paid third-party service that is not bundled with or hosted by this project; using it requires your own EACHLABS_API_KEY and is off by default in config/config.yaml under integrations.eachlabs.
